stations.title: Tomasz
stations.say: My card is squashed on my phone.

stations.title: Laptop layout
stations.text: Three fixed cards in every row.
stations.note: Only ever checked on a laptop.

captions: The styles live in one place. Next, Tomasz opens his history walk on his phone.
The cards are thin strips, pictures stick out and a word runs off the edge.
You write a layout that bends to the screen, in three tasks.
Now the history walk card fits his phone, and a wide screen too.
Same cards, any screen. Nothing pokes out any more.
